description: Bridge a running ComfyUI server: drops the TDComfyUI .tox if installed, otherwise builds a stock webclientDAT skeleton. The container exposes a Null TOP at <container>/out as the downstream output.

active.description: Start polling / streaming immediately. Default off so the artist can sanity-check first.

mode.description: 'auto' tries tox_drop first then falls back to webclient. Force one explicitly when you know which is installed.

output_mode.description: How the generated frame is pulled back into TD. 'file_watch' reloads ComfyUI's output folder via a movieFileInTOP.

output_source_name.description: Spout sender / Syphon server / NDI source name to receive on. Must match the ComfyUI side.

output_top_name.description: Name of the Null TOP exposed inside the container as the downstream output.

parent_path.description: COMP that will receive the ComfyUI container.

poll_interval_seconds.description: (webclient) How often to poll /history for completion.

server_url.description: ComfyUI server base URL — host:port of `python main.py --listen`.

source_top_path.description: (webclient) TOP whose current frame is sent as the workflow input image via Syphon/Spout re-broadcast.

tox_path.description: Explicit .tox path. When omitted, candidates are probed in order: olegchomp/TDComfyUI, JiSenHua/ComfyUI-TD.

watch_folder.description: (output_mode=file_watch) Folder ComfyUI writes outputs to. The movieFileInTOP cycles the newest file.

workflow_json_path.description: Absolute path to a ComfyUI workflow JSON exported from the web UI (Save (API Format)). Required for webclient mode.

name: connect_comfyui
title: Connect ComfyUI
